claims.title: Exact stochastic reuse boundary and sharp recorded-bit resource laws

quoted_fields.interface: Actual old X must already have lawP BEFORE any selection;fresh independentP andQ samples are callable,with no probabilities,densities,common random seed or equality certificate. One parameter-independent algorithm must output EXACTQ for every law pair in its declared class. General theorem uses all probability laws on a standard Borel space and almost-sure finite stopping,even allowing infinite expected work. Binary frontiers usep,q in(0,1),fresh calls count only;the old bit is already paid. General transport theorem fixesr old samples INCLUDINGX ands target draws,not an arbitrary adaptive total budget.
quoted_fields.failure: Universal exactness over ALLlaws and literal equality are essential. Supplied equality promise makes copying valid;known restricted families,density/common-seed access,approximate law,observable accuracy andfinite quantization change the problem. General-state optimality covers fixed per-source budgets,not arbitrary adaptive allocation of one total budget. Measurable-kernel attainment is not automatically computable execution;effective finite cost comparisons/optimization are extra. Expected-budget sharpness is established at odd budgets,hard-cap sharpness at every integer cap. Rare-outcome selection changes old-law contract and can make conditional repair expensive. Empirical OT is the strongest matched optimum,not beaten here. No physical counterfactual or end-to-end computational/physical capability follows.
